description: Add an optimisation to the register with status vorgeschlagen (admins/planners, or an agent permitted to). Required: art (agent|software|algorithmus), titel. Optional: ziel_typ (agent|ablauf|werkzeug|skill|software), ziel_id, ablauf, kanal, anlass (why — failing metric, run, fitness case), belege (ids), vorschlag (what to change), ticket_id (adds a 'ticket' event right away), plattformweit (superadmin only: no tenant, e.g. a software fix for all tenants). Returns { id, stand }.

anlass.description: Why it is proposed (failing metric, run, fitness case)

belege.description: IDs of evidence (runs, handoffs, fitness cases)

plattformweit.description: Superadmin only: platform-wide item without tenant

ziel_typ.description: What is targeted: agent, ablauf, werkzeug, skill or software

name: propose_optimierung
